# REFERENCE FIXTURE: load function definitions only; not an analysis entry point.
sample_density_proposal <- function(n, data, LOD, beta_m) {
  # Linear predictor for L variables
  meanL <- as.matrix(data[c("L1", "L2", "L3")]) %*% beta_m[c("L1", "L2", "L3")]
  # Mean calculation for the normal distribution
  means <- beta_m["A"] * data$A + meanL + beta_m["b0"] + beta_m["AL1"]*data$A*data$L1
  # Initialize an empty vector to store valid samples
  valid_samples <- numeric(0)
  
  # Log-normal sampling loop until we have enough valid samples
  while (length(valid_samples) < n) {
    # Draw more samples to fill the request
    remaining <- n - length(valid_samples)
    # Draw samples from a log-normal distribution
    samples <- rlnorm(remaining, meanlog = means, sdlog = beta_m["sd"])
    # Append valid samples (less than LOD)
    valid_samples <- c(valid_samples, samples[samples <= LOD])
  }
  
  # Return only the first n valid samples
  return(valid_samples[1:n])
}

compute_f_M <- function(data, beta_m) {
  # Calculate linear predictors for the mean of the normal distribution
  meanL <- as.matrix(data[, .(L1, L2, L3)]) %*% beta_m[c("L1", "L2", "L3")]
  # Total predicted mean
  means <- beta_m["A"] * data$A + meanL + beta_m["b0"] + beta_m["AL1"]*data$A*data$L1
  
  # Compute the log-normal density for each M
  # Convert the mean to a log scale for log-normal parameters
  f_M <- dlnorm(data$M, meanlog = means, sdlog = beta_m["sd"])
  return(f_M)
}

compute_f_M_HAL <- function(data, K = 3, epsilon = 1e-8) {
  # Check for required variables
  required_vars <- c("M", "L1", "L2", "L3", "A")
  missing_vars <- setdiff(required_vars, names(data))
  if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
    stop("Missing required variables: ", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  # Ensure we have weights
  if (!"w_norm" %in% names(data) || is.null(data$w_norm)) {
    data$w_norm <- 1
  }
  
  # Create fold assignments
  n <- nrow(data)
  fold_ids <- sample(rep(1:K, length.out = n))
  f_M_all <- numeric(n)
  
  for (k in 1:K) {
    # Split data
    train_data <- data[fold_ids != k, ]
    valid_data <- data[fold_ids == k, ]
    
    # Fit model on training data
    fit_k <- nadir::lnr_heteroskedastic_density(
      data = train_data,
      formula = M ~ L1 + L2 + L3 + A,
      mean_lnr = lnr_hal,
      var_lnr  = lnr_hal,
      mean_lnr_args = list(
        weights = train_data$w_norm,
        smoothness_orders = 1,
        max_degree        = 2,
        num_knots         = c(100, 75, 50),
        fit_control = list(
          cv_select       = TRUE,
          use_min         = TRUE,
          lambda.min.ratio= 1e-5,
          prediction_bounds = "default"
        )
      ),
      var_lnr_args = list(
        weights = train_data$w_norm,
        smoothness_orders = 1,
        max_degree        = 2,
        num_knots         = c(100, 75, 50),
        fit_control = list(
          cv_select       = TRUE,
          use_min         = TRUE,
          lambda.min.ratio= 1e-5,
          prediction_bounds = "default"
        )
      )
    )
    
    # Predict density on validation data
    f_M_valid <- fit_k(valid_data)
    f_M_valid <- pmax(f_M_valid, epsilon)  # stability
    
    # Store results
    f_M_all[fold_ids == k] <- f_M_valid
  }
  
  # Compute cross-fitted loss
  loss <- mean(-log(f_M_all))
  # loss <- sum(-log(f_M_all))
  
  
  return(list(
    f_M = f_M_all,
    loss = loss,
    fold_ids = fold_ids
  ))
}

Impute_step <- function(data, beta_m, S, LOD) {
  # Duplicate and impute LOD rows
  imputed_rows_list <- lapply(1:nrow(data[data$M == "LOD", ]), function(i) {
    replicated_row <- data[data$M == "LOD", ][rep(i, S), , drop = FALSE]
    replicated_row$M <- sample_density_proposal(
      n = S,
      data = as.data.frame(replicated_row),
      LOD = LOD,
      beta_m = beta_m
    )
    return(replicated_row)
  })
  
  # Combine non-LOD data with imputed LOD rows
  data <- rbind(data[data$M != "LOD", ], do.call(rbind, imputed_rows_list))
  # Convert all character columns to numeric or factor as needed
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.character), as.numeric))
  # Ensure the outcome and weights are numeric
  data$C <- as.integer(data$C)
  return(data[order(data$id), ])
}

mod_update_hal <- function(data, basis_list = NULL) {
  # Check and assign w_norm if NULL (for the initial value of the weights)
  if (is.null(data$w_norm)) {
    data$w_norm <- 1
  }
  
  x_names <- c("L1", "L2", "L3", "A", "M")
  y_out_names <- "Y"
  weights_names <- "w_norm"
  
  # fit enumerate_basis on full data to get set of basis functions
  if (is.null(basis_list)) {
    basis_list <- hal9001::enumerate_basis(
      as.matrix(data[, ..x_names]),
      max_degree = 2, 
      smoothness_orders = 1, 
      num_knots = c(100, 75, 50)
    )
  }
  # Function to fit HAL model
  out_mod <- hal9001::fit_hal(
    X = as.matrix(data[, ..x_names]),
    Y = as.numeric(data[, get(y_out_names)]),
    weights = as.numeric(data[, get(weights_names)]),
    family = "binomial",
    basis_list = basis_list,
    fit_control = list(
      cv_select = TRUE,
      use_min = TRUE,
      lambda.min.ratio = 1e-5,
      prediction_bounds = "default"
    )
  )
  
  out_probY1 <- predict(out_mod, new_data = as.matrix(data[, ..x_names]), type = "response")
  out_probY0 <- 1 - out_probY1
  
  # Create a new column for predicted probabilities based on observed Y values
  out_prob <- ifelse(data$Y == 1, out_probY1, out_probY0)
  
  # Return predictions, coefficients, and terms
  return(list(
    out_prob = out_prob,
    basis_list = basis_list
  ))
}

Wet_step <- function(data_imputed, mod_pred, beta_m_0) {
  # Update probabilities
  #data_imputed$cen_prob <- pmin(pmax(mod_pred$cen_prob, 1e-40), 1 - 1e-40)
  data_imputed$out_prob <- mod_pred$out_prob
  
  Mdens_HAL <- compute_f_M_HAL(data = data_imputed)
  data_imputed$Mdens_new <- Mdens_HAL$f_M
  Mdens_error <- Mdens_HAL$loss
  
  # Filter censored data
  censored_data <- data_imputed[data_imputed$C == 0, ]
  cendens_new <- censored_data$Mdens_new
  cendens_int <- compute_f_M(censored_data, beta_m_0)
  
  censored_data$w <- censored_data$out_prob * (cendens_new / cendens_int)
  
  # Normalize weights by ID
  censored_data$w_norm <- ave(censored_data$w, censored_data$id, FUN = function(x) x / sum(x))
  
  # For uncensored data
  uncensored_data <- data_imputed[data_imputed$C == 1, ]
  uncensored_data$w_norm <- 1
  uncensored_data$w <- 1
  data_imputed <- rbind(censored_data, uncensored_data)
  
  # Remove temporary columns
  data_weted <- data_imputed[, !names(data_imputed) %in% c("out_prob"), with = FALSE]
  return(list(wet_dat = data_weted[order(data_weted$id),], dens_errors = Mdens_error))
}

EM_algorithm <- function(data, beta_m_0, S = 2, LOD = LOD_value, max_iter = 100, tol = 1e-5, verbose = TRUE) {
  iter <- 0; diff <- Inf; rel_diff <- Inf
  
  # I-Step: Initial Imputation
  data_imputed <- Impute_step(data, beta_m_0, S, LOD)
  halmod_pred <- mod_update_hal(data = data_imputed)
  halbasis <- halmod_pred$basis_list
  wet_step <- Wet_step(data_imputed = data_imputed, mod_pred = halmod_pred, beta_m_0 = beta_m_0)
  data_weted <- wet_step$wet_dat
  
  start_time <- Sys.time()  # Track total runtime
  
  while (iter < max_iter && diff > tol && rel_diff > tol) {
    iter_time <- Sys.time()
    
    # W-Step
    wet_step <- Wet_step(data_imputed = data_weted, mod_pred = halmod_pred, beta_m_0 = beta_m_0)
    
    data_weted <- wet_step$wet_dat
    errors <- wet_step$dens_errors
    
    # M-Step
    errors_new <- compute_f_M_HAL(data = data_weted)$loss
    
    # Compute Convergence Criteria
    diff <- sum((errors_new - errors)^2)
    
    out_coef_old <- halmod_pred$out_coef
    
    # Parameter Update
    halmod_pred <- mod_update_hal(data_weted, basis_list = halbasis)
    
    # Update diff with coefficient changes
    #diff <- diff + sum((halmod_pred$out_coef - out_coef_old)^2)
    
    # Fixed denominator issue in rel_diff calculation
    # rel_diff <- diff / (sum(errors^2) + sum(out_coef_old^2) + 1e-8)  # Prevent division by zero
    rel_diff <- diff / (sum(errors^2) + 1e-8)  # Prevent division by zero
    
    iter_time_end <- Sys.time()
    iter_duration <- round(difftime(iter_time_end, iter_time, units = "secs"), 4)
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("Iteration:", iter, 
          "| Absolute Diff:", diff, 
          "| Relative Diff:", rel_diff,
          "| Time:", iter_duration, "s\n")
    }
    
    iter <- iter + 1
  }
  
  total_runtime <- round(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs"), 4)
  
  # Stopping condition logging
  if (iter >= max_iter) {
    message("EM Algorithm stopped: Maximum iterations reached (", max_iter, ").")
  } else if (diff <= tol || rel_diff <= tol) {
    message("EM Algorithm converged successfully in ", iter, " iterations.")
  }
  
  cat("Total Runtime:", total_runtime, "seconds\n")
  
  return(list(data_weted = data_weted))
}

moutn_multiplier_bootstrap <- function(eif, theta, B = 200, m = 100,  multipliers = "rademacher", ci_level = 0.95) {
  n <- length(eif)
  samples <- sample(1:n, size = m, replace = F)
  eif <- eif[samples]
  
  m_process <- numeric(B)
  se_eif <- sqrt(stats::var(eif) / n)
  
  for (b in 1:B) {
    # Step 1: Draw multipliers
    if (multipliers == "rademacher") {
      xi <- (2 * stats::rbinom(length(samples), 1, 0.5)) - 1
    } else if (multipliers == "gaussian") {
      xi <- rnorm(length(samples))
    }
    
    # Step 2: compute process M using multipliers
    m_process[b] <- mean((xi * eif) / se_eif)
  }
  
  c_alpha <- unname(stats::quantile(m_process, ci_level, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  
  lwr_ci <- theta - c_alpha * se_eif
  upr_ci <- theta + c_alpha * se_eif
  return(list(m_process = m_process,
              lwr_ci = lwr_ci,
              upr_ci = upr_ci,
              ci = c(lwr_ci, upr_ci),
              c_alpha = c_alpha))
}

os_compute_eff <- function(data, indices, type = c("NDE", "NIE"), fast = FALSE) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  sample_data <- data[indices, ]  # Resample data
  
  # Choose function based on fast argument
  if (fast) {
    bres <- Onestep_med_effs_fast(dat_aug = sample_data, effect = type)
  } else {
    bres <- Onestep_med_effs(dat_aug = sample_data, effect = type)
  }
  
  # Extract estimate and EIF
  est_name <- if (type == "NDE") "nde_onestep_est" else "nie_onestep_est"
  
  return(list(
    eif = bres$eif,          # Assumes eif is always returned regardless of effect
    est = bres[[est_name]]
  ))
}

os_choose_ci <- function(data, original_estimate, p_cen = 0.5, k = 5, gamma_seq = seq(0.001, 30, length.out = 100), B1 = 100, B2 = 50000, 
                         nominal_coverage = 0.95, type = c("NDE", "NIE")) {
  n <- nrow(data)  # Original sample size
  
  # Initialize variables
  coverage_rates <- numeric(length(gamma_seq))
  optimal_c <- NA
  opt_m <- NA
  early_stop <- FALSE  # Flag to indicate early stopping
  
  # Loop over gamma_seq manually to allow early stopping
  for (i in seq_along(gamma_seq)) {
    if (early_stop) break  # Exit the loop if early stop is triggered
    
    gamma <- gamma_seq[i]
    
    # Compute c_i
    c_i <- (1 + gamma * exp(- k*p_cen)) / (1 + gamma)
    m_i <- floor(n^c_i)  # Compute m_i
    
    # Parallelize the first-stage bootstrap (B1 iterations)
    coverage_rate <- future_sapply(1:B1, function(b1) {
      first_stage_indices <- sample(1:n, n, replace = TRUE)  # Resample data
      #first_stage_estimate <- compute_eff(data, first_stage_indices, type = type, measure = measure)
      
      # Second-stage (nested) bootstrap
      os_eff <- os_compute_eff(data = data, indices = first_stage_indices, type = type, fast = T)
      nested_res <- moutn_multiplier_bootstrap(eif = os_eff$eif, theta = os_eff$est, B = B2, m = m_i)
      nested_ci <- nested_res$ci
      
      # Check if the original estimate falls within the CI
      if (original_estimate >= nested_ci[1] && original_estimate <= nested_ci[2]) 1 else 0
    }, future.seed = TRUE)  # Ensure reproducibility
    
    # Calculate the coverage rate for this gamma
    coverage_rates[i] <- mean(coverage_rate)
    
    # Check if the coverage rate exceeds the nominal coverage
    if (coverage_rates[i] >= nominal_coverage) {
      optimal_c <- c_i
      opt_m <- m_i
      early_stop <- TRUE  # Trigger early stopping
      cat("Stopping early at gamma =", gamma, "with coverage rate =", coverage_rates[i], "\n")
    }
    
    cat("Iteration", i, "gamma =", gamma, "coverage rate =", coverage_rates[i], "\n")
  }
  
  # If no gamma achieved the nominal coverage, select the one with the highest coverage rate
  if (is.na(optimal_c)) {
    opt_gamma <- gamma_seq[which.max(coverage_rates)]
    optimal_c <- (1 + opt_gamma * exp(- k*p_cen)) / (1 + opt_gamma)
    opt_m <- floor(n^optimal_c)
    cat("No gamma achieved the nominal coverage. Selecting gamma with the highest coverage rate:", optimal_c, "\n")
  }
  
  return(list(
    optimal_c = optimal_c,
    coverage_rates = data.frame(c = gamma_seq, coverage_rate = coverage_rates),
    opt_m = opt_m
  ))
}

Onestep_med_effs <- function(dat_aug, effect = c("both", "NDE", "NIE")) {
  effect <- match.arg(effect)
  
  # Learners
  glm_lrnr <- Lrnr_glm_fast$new()
  lrn_ridge <- Lrnr_glmnet$new(alpha = 0)
  lrn_lasso <- Lrnr_glmnet$new(alpha = 1)
  lrn_earth <- Lrnr_earth$new()
  lrn_ranger <- Lrnr_ranger$new(
    probability = TRUE, num.trees = 200,
    mtry = 2, min.node.size = 5
  )
  lrn_xgb <- Lrnr_xgboost$new(
    objective = "binary:logistic",
    max_depth = 3, eta = 0.15, nrounds = 200,
    subsample = 0.9, colsample_bytree = 0.9,
    min_child_weight = 5, gamma = 0.1, verbosity = 0
  )
  lrn_gam <- Lrnr_gam$new()
  lrn_hal <- Lrnr_hal9001$new(
    family = "binomial", max_degree = 2, smoothness_orders = 1,
    num_knots = c(100, 75, 50),
    fit_control = list(
      cv_select = TRUE, use_min = TRUE,
      lambda.min.ratio = 1e-5, prediction_bounds = "default"
    )
  )
  
  lrnr_lib <- Stack$new(lrn_hal, lrn_earth, lrn_xgb)
  sl_lrnr <- Lrnr_sl$new(learners = lrnr_lib, metalearner = Lrnr_solnp$new())
  glm_lrnr <- Lrnr_glm_fast$new(family = binomial())
  
  # Define interactions
  lrnr_interact1 <- Lrnr_define_interactions$new(list(c("W_1", "W_3"), c("W_1", "W_2")))
  lrnr_interact2 <- Lrnr_define_interactions$new(list(c("A", "M_1"), c("A", "W_1")))
  lrnr_interact3 <- Lrnr_define_interactions$new(list(c("W_1", "W_3"), c("W_1", "W_2"), c("W_2", "W_3")))
  lrnr_interact4 <- Lrnr_define_interactions$new(list(c("A", "M_1"), c("A", "W_1"), c("M_1", "W_3")))
  
  interaction_pipeline_glmPS <- sl3::make_learner(sl3::Pipeline, lrnr_interact1, glm_lrnr)
  interaction_pipeline_glmPS2 <- sl3::make_learner(sl3::Pipeline, lrnr_interact3, glm_lrnr)
  interaction_pipeline_glmOUT <- sl3::make_learner(sl3::Pipeline, lrnr_interact2, glm_lrnr)
  interaction_pipeline_glmOUT2 <- sl3::make_learner(sl3::Pipeline, lrnr_interact4, glm_lrnr)
  
  result_list <- list()
  
  # ---- NDE ----
  if (effect %in% c("both", "NDE")) {
    nde_onestep <- medoutcon(
      W = dat_aug[, c("L1", "L2", "L3")],
      A = as.numeric(dat_aug$A),
      Z = NULL,
      M = dat_aug$M,
      Y = dat_aug$Y,
      obs_weights = dat_aug$w_norm,
      g_learners = interaction_pipeline_glmPS2,
      h_learners = lrn_xgb,
      b_learners = interaction_pipeline_glmOUT2,
      v_learners = lrn_xgb,
      effect = "direct",
      estimator = "onestep",
      estimator_args = list(cv_folds = 15L, max_iter = 5L, tiltmod_tol = 5)
    )
    
    nde_os <- summary(nde_onestep)
    result_list$eif <- nde_onestep$eif
    result_list$nde_onestep_est <- nde_os$param_est
    result_list$nde_onestep_var <- nde_os$var_est
    result_list$nde_onestep_ci_sd <- c(nde_os$lwr_ci, nde_os$upr_ci)
    result_list$nde_onestep_ci <- c(
      nde_os$param_est - 2.12 * sqrt(nde_os$var_est),
      nde_os$param_est + 2.12 * sqrt(nde_os$var_est)
    )
  }
  
  # ---- NIE ----
  if (effect %in% c("both", "NIE")) {
    nie_onestep <- medoutcon(
      W = dat_aug[, c("L1", "L2", "L3")],
      A = as.numeric(dat_aug$A),
      Z = NULL,
      M = dat_aug$M,
      Y = dat_aug$Y,
      obs_weights = dat_aug$w_norm,
      g_learners = interaction_pipeline_glmPS2,
      h_learners = lrn_xgb,
      b_learners = interaction_pipeline_glmOUT2,
      v_learners = lrn_xgb,
      effect = "indirect",
      estimator = "onestep",
      estimator_args = list(cv_folds = 15L, max_iter = 5L, tiltmod_tol = 5)
    )
    
    nie_os <- summary(nie_onestep)
    result_list$eif <- nie_onestep$eif
    result_list$nie_onestep_est <- nie_os$param_est
    result_list$nie_onestep_var <- nie_os$var_est
    result_list$nie_onestep_ci_sd <- c(nie_os$lwr_ci, nie_os$upr_ci)
    result_list$nie_onestep_ci <- c(
      nie_os$param_est - 2.12 * sqrt(nie_os$var_est),
      nie_os$param_est + 2.12 * sqrt(nie_os$var_est)
    )
  }
  
  return(result_list)
}

Onestep_med_effs_fast <- function(dat_aug, effect = c("both", "NDE", "NIE")) {
  effect <- match.arg(effect)
  
  # Learners
  glm_lrnr <- Lrnr_glm_fast$new()
  lrn_ridge <- Lrnr_glmnet$new(alpha = 0)
  lrn_lasso <- Lrnr_glmnet$new(alpha = 1)
  lrn_earth <- Lrnr_earth$new()
  lrn_ranger <- Lrnr_ranger$new(
    probability = TRUE, num.trees = 200,
    mtry = 2, min.node.size = 5
  )
  lrn_xgb <- Lrnr_xgboost$new(
    objective = "binary:logistic",
    max_depth = 3, eta = 0.15, nrounds = 200,
    subsample = 0.9, colsample_bytree = 0.9,
    min_child_weight = 5, gamma = 0.1, verbosity = 0
  )
  lrn_gam <- Lrnr_gam$new()
  lrn_hal <- Lrnr_hal9001$new(
    family = "binomial", max_degree = 2, smoothness_orders = 1,
    num_knots = c(100, 75, 50),
    fit_control = list(
      cv_select = TRUE, use_min = TRUE,
      lambda.min.ratio = 1e-5, prediction_bounds = "default"
    )
  )
  
  lrnr_lib <- Stack$new(lrn_hal, lrn_earth, lrn_xgb)
  sl_lrnr <- Lrnr_sl$new(learners = lrnr_lib, metalearner = Lrnr_solnp$new())
  glm_lrnr <- Lrnr_glm_fast$new(family = binomial())
  
  # Define interactions
  lrnr_interact1 <- Lrnr_define_interactions$new(list(c("W_1", "W_3"), c("W_1", "W_2")))
  lrnr_interact2 <- Lrnr_define_interactions$new(list(c("A", "M_1"), c("A", "W_1")))
  lrnr_interact3 <- Lrnr_define_interactions$new(list(c("W_1", "W_3"), c("W_1", "W_2"), c("W_2", "W_3")))
  lrnr_interact4 <- Lrnr_define_interactions$new(list(c("A", "M_1"), c("A", "W_1"), c("M_1", "W_3")))
  
  interaction_pipeline_glmPS <- sl3::make_learner(sl3::Pipeline, lrnr_interact1, glm_lrnr)
  interaction_pipeline_glmPS2 <- sl3::make_learner(sl3::Pipeline, lrnr_interact3, glm_lrnr)
  interaction_pipeline_glmOUT <- sl3::make_learner(sl3::Pipeline, lrnr_interact2, glm_lrnr)
  interaction_pipeline_glmOUT2 <- sl3::make_learner(sl3::Pipeline, lrnr_interact4, glm_lrnr)
  
  result_list <- list()
  
  # ---- NDE ----
  if (effect %in% c("both", "NDE")) {
    nde_onestep <- medoutcon(
      W = dat_aug[, c("L1", "L2", "L3")],
      A = as.numeric(dat_aug$A),
      Z = NULL,
      M = dat_aug$M,
      Y = dat_aug$Y,
      obs_weights = dat_aug$w_norm,
      g_learners = interaction_pipeline_glmPS2,
      h_learners = lrn_xgb,
      b_learners = interaction_pipeline_glmOUT2,
      effect = "direct",
      estimator = "onestep",
      estimator_args = list(cv_folds = 2L, max_iter = 5L, tiltmod_tol = 5)
    )
    
    nde_os <- summary(nde_onestep)
    result_list$eif <- nde_onestep$eif
    result_list$nde_onestep_est <- nde_os$param_est
    result_list$nde_onestep_var <- nde_os$var_est
    result_list$nde_onestep_ci_sd <- c(nde_os$lwr_ci, nde_os$upr_ci)
    result_list$nde_onestep_ci <- c(
      nde_os$param_est - 2.12 * sqrt(nde_os$var_est),
      nde_os$param_est + 2.12 * sqrt(nde_os$var_est)
    )
  }
  
  # ---- NIE ----
  if (effect %in% c("both", "NIE")) {
    nie_onestep <- medoutcon(
      W = dat_aug[, c("L1", "L2", "L3")],
      A = as.numeric(dat_aug$A),
      Z = NULL,
      M = dat_aug$M,
      Y = dat_aug$Y,
      obs_weights = dat_aug$w_norm,
      g_learners = interaction_pipeline_glmPS2,
      h_learners = lrn_xgb,
      b_learners = interaction_pipeline_glmOUT2,
      v_learners = lrn_xgb,
      effect = "indirect",
      estimator = "onestep",
      estimator_args = list(cv_folds = 2L, max_iter = 5L, tiltmod_tol = 5)
    )
    
    nie_os <- summary(nie_onestep)
    result_list$eif <- nie_onestep$eif
    result_list$nie_onestep_est <- nie_os$param_est
    result_list$nie_onestep_var <- nie_os$var_est
    result_list$nie_onestep_ci_sd <- c(nie_os$lwr_ci, nie_os$upr_ci)
    result_list$nie_onestep_ci <- c(
      nie_os$param_est - 2.12 * sqrt(nie_os$var_est),
      nie_os$param_est + 2.12 * sqrt(nie_os$var_est)
    )
  }
  
  return(result_list)
}

sim_iteration <- function(i, n_obs, k = 5, type = c("Trad", "EM-MLE", "Oracle"), censor_rate, S, beta_m) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  output_file <- paste0("results/regression-fixture-output", type, "_n_", n_obs, "rate", censor_rate, ".txt")
  data <- Study_dgp_Mcensor(n_obs = n_obs, censor_rate = censor_rate)
  simdata <- data$study_dat
  LOD_value <- as.numeric(data$lod)
  
  if (type == "Trad") {
    data_aug <- NaiveImpute(simdata, LOD_value)
  } else if (type == "EM-MLE") {
    em_result <- EM_algorithm(simdata, beta_m, S = S, LOD = LOD_value)
    data_aug <- em_result$data_weted
    beta_m <- em_result$beta_m  
  } else if (type == "Oracle") {
    data_aug <- data$study_dat_full
  }
  
  # One-step estimation
  onestep.nde <- Onestep_med_effs(dat_aug = data_aug, effect = "NDE")
  # m-out-of-n #p_cen = 0.5, k = 5, 
  choose_ciNDE <- os_choose_ci(data = data_aug, original_estimate = onestep.nde$nde_onestep_est, p_cen = censor_rate, k = k, type = "NDE")
  CI.nderes <- moutn_multiplier_bootstrap(eif = onestep.nde$eif, theta = onestep.nde$nde_onestep_est, 
                                          B = 2000, m = choose_ciNDE$opt_m)
  CI.nde <- CI.nderes$ci
  
  onestep.nie <- Onestep_med_effs(dat_aug = data_aug, effect = "NIE")
  #choose_ciNIE <- os_choose_ci(data = data_aug, original_estimate = onestep.nie$nie_onestep_est, p_cen = censor_rate, k = k, type = "NIE")
  CI.nieres <- moutn_multiplier_bootstrap(eif = onestep.nie$eif, theta = onestep.nie$nie_onestep_est,
                                          B = 2000, m = choose_ciNDE$opt_m)
  CI.nie <- CI.nieres$ci
  # Save results
  results <- c(i,
               onestep.nde$nde_onestep_est, CI.nde, onestep.nde$nde_onestep_ci_sd, onestep.nde$nde_onestep_var, 
               onestep.nie$nie_onestep_est, CI.nie, onestep.nie$nie_onestep_ci_sd, onestep.nie$nie_onestep_var, choose_ciNDE$optimal_c)
  
  
  write(results, file = output_file, ncolumns = length(results), append = TRUE)
  return(NULL)  # Returning NULL keeps memory usage low
}
